text:
Sam (sales): Quick handoff for TidalCare — new customer (Anita Patel). Signed 12mo, 10M tokens/month, trial kickoff next Mon. Renewal around Q3 2026 (flag as medium risk early because they require SSO + data residency).

Sam (sales): Key priorities: latency p95 <150ms, data isolation for PHI-ish data, embeddings for large batch indexing. If hosted can't meet latency we'll need Dedicated estimate.

Sam (sales): Links: onboarding guide https://redwood.internal/onboarding/tidalcare, demo recording (internal), SSO checklist: https://redwood.internal/sso-checklist. I've uploaded SAML metadata to the shared drive.

Maya (cs): Ack — I'll own onboarding. Scheduled kickoff: Wed 10am PT (please add Anita + Sam). Targets for first 30 days: 1) Sandbox keys + basic integration, 2) SSO test in staging, 3) perf baseline + success metrics doc.

Maya (cs): Need from sales: sample prompt set + expected QPS and batch sizes for embeddings, confirmation of SSO vendor (Okta?) and whether they need on-prem/residency region. Also need staging service account creds.

Sam (sales): Confirmed Okta. They run mix: near-real-time chat (~50 qps bursts) + nightly embeddings batch (~200k docs). I'll send sample payloads and staging creds now.

Priya (support): Noted. Opening support ticket for SSO onboarding + token quota. Also FYI there was a prior embedding mismatch with model "embed-lite-v1" during high-batch runs — tagging eng to investigate before the customer imports 200k docs.

Priya (support): Creating ticket and scheduling a pre-onboard triage with eng.

Oncall Bot: Ticket CS-4821 created by Priya: "TidalCare SSO integration + embedding mismatch during batch import" — assigned to Luca (eng). Link: https://redwood.internal/support/CS-4821

Luca (eng): I can take CS-4821. Will run a small repro on staging Wed 3pm PT. Need sample payloads + expected latency targets. If embeddings mismatch reproduces, I'll try pinned model vs. quantized variant and send notes.

Luca (eng): Quick loadtest snippet for staging (run from ops host):

```
# run loadtest
python tools/loadtest.py --host staging-redwood --profile tidalcare --qps 50 --duration 300
```

Maya (cs): Plan summary + owners: 1) SSO setup + SAML metadata (Priya) 2) Sandbox/API keys & onboarding docs (Maya) 3) Perf baseline & smoke tests (Luca) 4) Success metrics & weekly check-ins (Maya).

Maya (cs): Action items: Sam to send sample payloads and invite to kickoff (Sam). Priya to open support ticket (done: CS-4821). Luca to run repro and perf test Wed 3pm. I'll draft a 30/60/90 success plan and share before kickoff.

Sam (sales): Sent sample payloads to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/tidalcare/samples. Also added Anita + engineering contacts to the kickoff invite.

Priya (support): Attached support checklist to CS-4821 and added notes about token caps and SSO attributes required.

Luca (eng): Got the sample payloads. I'll run the repro and post results in the ticket thread. If we hit p95 >150ms on hosted, I'll request a Dedicated smoke-run and cost estimate.

Maya (cs): Good. I'll capture renewal risk as "medium" in the account health doc because SSO/residency are gating items; if we can't validate residency they'll consider other vendors. Weekly syncs for 6 weeks. :white_check_mark:

Sam (sales): Thanks team — will follow up after kickoff. cc @Anita (customer) will expect roadmap and success metrics during the call.

Maya (cs): Closing notes: next updates in this thread after Wed kickoff and Wed perf test.
